description: Single-engined Mooney M20E flown from Lisbon to Macau in 1987 and preserved on display in Seac Pai Van Park; Coloane; the year given is the year of the flight not necessarily the year of construction and is recorded because the OSM node gives start_date 1987 for the display; construction year is genuinely unknown
